english.title: Fail comply with requirement to supply financial statement for parental compensation order - Crime and Disorder
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on an application by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL AUTHORITY..) to **(..SPECIFY THE MAGISTRATES' COURT..) for the issue of a parental compensation order, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement to provide a statement of your financial circumstances
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13B(4) and (5) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998
